Mailing Address Change Request
Instructions: Please use this form to update the mailing address for your property tax statements. To ensure your request is processed accurately, please have your Parcel Number (PIN) ready, which can be found on your most recent tax bill or through our online property search. Important Notes: Property Ownership: This form only updates where your tax bills are mailed. It does not legally change the ownership names on the deed. Legal name changes must be handled through the Recorder’s Office. Processing Time: Please allow 5 to 7 business days for the update to reflect in our system. Deadline: To ensure your next tax statement reaches the correct location, please submit your change at least 30 days prior to the annual mailing date.

The office of County Treasurer was created by the state constitution. Treasurers take office in May, are elected for four-year terms on a non-partisan ballot during November elections, and their salary is set by state statute and based on the population of the county. The full duties are listed in the North Dakota Century Code. They include receiving all incoming money, balancing accounts, collect fees and fines, invest funds to receive the best return, and provide information to lending agencies.

Tax statements are usually mailed in early December, but no later than December 26th according to the NDCC.
Failure to receive a statement shall not relieve the owner of liability, nor extend the discount privilege past the February 15th deadline. Please call as soon as possible if you do not receive a statement.
If February 15th falls on President’s Day, the 5% discount deadline is extended to the next business day. Postmarks are used to determine if the payment was made timely.
Please send your payment with your statement stub or include your fourteen-digit parcel number or legal description such as lots and blocks with addition, or section, township & range.
Our mailing address is:
Walsh County Treasurer
600 Cooper Avenue
Grafton, ND 58237
Receipts are only mailed upon request.
No refund is given if an overpayment is $4.99 or less. NDCC 11-10-29
